title: radermachera ghorta
intro: Radermachera ghorta, commonly known as the Dwarf Mallard, is a type of flowering plant. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress. Therapeutically, Radermachera ghorta has been used to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, demonstrating its potential in alleviating symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and medicinal applications.
